title: Checklist accuracy and fixture gaps from QA run 31486 (owed list, 73 items): 22 item corrections and 4 coverage gaps, one card for the family
body:
qa#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUARzLeR7GhKms8a5s

QA-source: #31486 · checklist-accuracy · the close-out collection

The checklist-accuracy findings, fixture gaps and partial-coverage gaps the QA run #31486 (subject `0647dabb`) met. None is a FAIL: the two stale-spec FAILs have their own re-point cards. This round has no wave anchor card, so they are collected here, one card for the family. Each line names the item and the correction the runner measured; the run record's comments carry the per-clause evidence.

## Item text corrections

1. `ai.mcp-http-surface` acceptance[4]: the HTTP tool set is 15 now; add `delete_records`, `read_file`, `create_upload_link` (registered in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`). The stdio door serves 10 (the 9 plus `delete_records`).
2. `studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows` steps[1]: "If-None-Match: * once the row exists" should say once the ACTIVE row exists; the precondition is per lifecycle, so an active save where only the draft row exists answers 200.
3. `dashboards.analytics-exposure-gate-and-measure-aggregate` fixtures.requires[2]: spell the scratch object's key `enable: { apiEnabled: false }`; a top-level `apiEnabled` is refused at compile.
4. `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` steps[1], [3], [4]: `os migrate apply` and `os migrate comment-reactions` take no `--dev` flag; only `migrate organization-ownership` and `serve` do.
5. `attachments-storage.field-accept-maxsize-server-enforced` fixtures.requires[2]: since #27399 the data door cannot be the system-write channel (the PATCH answers 200 and changes nothing); name a direct database write.
6. `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display` acceptance[3], steps[6]: the chip has no title attribute; basedOn is in the chip popover (`studio-override-popover-facts`), and Restore is the popover's `studio-override-restore` → `studio-restore-original-dialog` → `studio-restore-original-confirm` (`StudioCustomizeControls.tsx`, `StudioOverrideChip`).
7. `studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save`, dashboard variant: write `requiredPermissions` with a capability the admin holds (`studio.access`); one it lacks makes the dashboard unreadable to the admin.
8. `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep` steps[3], [6]: the Studio door is `/studio/PKG/metadata` (and `…/_diagnostics`), not `/apps/APP/metadata?package=`; a planted view's sweep entry is named after the expanded container (`OBJECT.default`).
9. `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` acceptance[3]: a Card from the picker has no properties and renders an empty box; set the card's title before publish so the render discriminates.
10. `studio-authoring.hooks-tab-authoring` steps[3], [5]: two throwing hooks on the same event and trigger hide the log-hook write behind the abort hook; fire each throwing body on a distinct record name.
11. `studio-authoring.actions-tab-presets`: every preset keeps the label "New action" and the overflow sits under "More actions"; give each preset a label in the steps.
12. `studio-authoring.validation-rules-authoring` acceptance[1]: the server-verdict shape needs one draft PUT to obtain the verdict; say "no further PUT while the served verdict stands".
13. `identity-auth.email-verification-loop`: the verification mail lives in `sys_identity_email`, not `sys_email`; the dev log transport does not deliver (#25060). Recipe that worked: run plugin-email's `fake-smtp.testkit.ts` with tsx, then `PUT /api/settings/mail {provider:'smtp', smtp_host:'127.0.0.1', smtp_port: PORT, smtp_secure:false, from_email, from_name}`.
14. `integration-system.email-template-render` knownGaps[1]: on the dev log transport the email channel is suppressed (`transport_not_configured`); use the same SMTP-sink recipe.
15. `access-security.permission-matrix-edit-loop` steps[2]: `/apps/setup/metadata/permission/NAME` redirects to `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/permission/NAME`, where the editor uses an explicit Save.
16. `automation.package-flow-override` steps[3], [7], [8]: the override chip is folded into `auto-item-more` as `studio-item-header-folded-chips`; Restore as in line 6; the runs list is at `data.runs`.
17. `cli.scaffold-first-run` pre-release recipe: verdaccio needs `max_body_size` raised (`@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/console` answer 413 otherwise) and a no-upstream rule for `@object-ui/*`; steps[4]: `npx skills add CHECKOUT --list` works as the repo-root discovery listing.
18. `platform-core.package-lifecycle-enable-disable` steps[5], acceptance[4]: `GET /api/v1/packages/ID/published` answers 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND; compare `GET /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME` before and after the revert. acceptance[5]: the app-level not-found is a full-screen named state ("This app can't be opened"); say "a named not-found state, not a white page".
19. `records-forms.form-view-gallery` fixtures.requires[0]: the package-less overlay PUT is the pre-ADR-0146-D11 shape; use `POST /packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`, then `PUT …?package=com.example.showcase.custom&mode=draft` with overrides, then publish-drafts; revert with DELETE on the pair. Once the pair exists, Studio Publish on the showcase leaves its read-only posture (#28562), so `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` variant 2 must run without it.
20. `records-forms.bulk-select-all-matching` steps[7]: `deleteMany` needs `{"ids":[…]}`; a bare array answers 400.
21. `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears` steps[4]: a contributor-bound member's popover drew an Activity tab (通知 / 审批 / 活动动态); the step says a member has none.
22. `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` variants[5]: the member-persona variant has a stock instance now: the task list's "Reassign…" with no row selected.

## Coverage gaps (PARTIAL or BLOCKED clauses this round)

- `attachments-storage.chunked-upload-integrity` acceptance[3]: needs a second organization; the walled group boot C3a provisioned (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group`) would serve it, and `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` (blocked, #9334) too.
- `automation.package-flow-override` acceptance[2]: prescribe a topology-changing override edit, or score the clause from its pin; a label-only edit cannot discriminate.
- `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix`: only 9 rows driven in one runner's budget; the item needs its own runner or a split.
- `studio-authoring.package-customize-restore-display` acceptance[6] (view render and exports) and `studio-authoring.validation-rules-authoring` acceptance[2] (Advanced rules through the editors): no pin covers them.

## Fixture hygiene

`studio-authoring.picklist-bound-select`: the scratch copy must sit inside the workspace for pnpm links, and the repo's command hook refuses `rm -rf` of it in the checkout; name a removal route the hook allows, or a copy location outside the checkout with `node_modules` linked.

Route: the checklist (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json`), `domain:devx`.
